summary: Frontend-only visual redesign audit of the new FOXY Property homepage (dev-foxy-pull preview). Verified ALL specified data-testid elements are present and wired correctly: header transparency at top vs dark translucent + blur after scrolling >40px, all 12 nav items + login/getStarted + mobile toggle, hero copy with STARTS HERE in gold, hero CTA hrefs, 7 scene rail buttons (desktop only), search tabs (buy/rent/invest/hmo) with active gold state, search-submit wiring that navigates to /properties?intent=<tab>&location=<value>, West London / Interior / Featured / Finale sections and their CTAs, Property Lab strategy tabs with correct lab-cta href per strategy (sell->/sell, let->/lettings, btl & hmo->/calculators/buy-to-let, refinance->/mortgages, manage->/property-management), HMO analysis panel content (£4,600 / £55,200 / £11,500 / £43,700 / 8.2%) with ILLUSTRATIVE label, HMO room labels lab-room-room1..5 visible on the house image at desktop, interior-price-panel content (£1,250,000 Kensington W8 3 bed / 2 bath / 1,450 sq ft + PROTOTYPE), 3 featured prototype card hrefs, mobile hamburger opens nav-mobile-panel at 390. Responsive: 0 horizontal overflow at 390/768/1440; scene rail hidden on mobile/tablet, visible on desktop; mobile-toggle hidden at 1440. Reveal animations: after gradual scroll, 0 elements are stuck at opacity-0 (the single opacity-0 element seen is the nav-buy hover dropdown, which is expected). Under prefers-reduced-motion:reduce, only the same hover dropdown remains hidden (expected). Regression: /properties, /areas, /sell, /landlords, /property-management all 200 with 0 console errors. Zero page errors captured across the entire run.

header.nav_buy_dropdown_on_hover: visible; items: For Sale, New Homes, Acquisitions, International Investors

property_lab.hmo_panel_text: Total Monthly Rent £4,600 / Annual £55,200 / Operating £11,500 / Net £43,700 / Estimated Yield 8.2% + ILLUSTRATIVE label

detailed_findings.interior_price_panel: £1,250,000 · Kensington, London W8 · 3 Bed · 2 Bath · 1,450 sqft · PROTOTYPE · NOT A LIVE PROPERTY

stuck_opacity0_after_scroll.note: nav-buy hover dropdown (invisible/opacity-0 by design, becomes group-hover:visible on hover) - not a bug

critical_code_review_comments: Search wiring emits intent=hmo/buy/rent/invest querystring, but /properties filter UI only exposes ALL/BUY/RENT tabs and does not appear to apply an HMO filter based on ?intent=hmo (0 results when navigating from HMO search with no other filters). The routing itself is correct per spec; consider surfacing an HMO/Invest filter or mapping ?intent=hmo to a sensible default so the landing page shows relevant results. Non-blocking for this review.
The nav-buy dropdown container uses `invisible opacity-0 group-hover:visible`. Consider also making it keyboard-focusable (focus-within) for a11y.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all 45+ specified testids present, all links & CTAs correct, 3-viewport responsive clean, reveals + reduced-motion clean, regression clean

context_for_next_testing_agent: New homepage redesign is fully wired and clean. Header transparency toggle, hero + scene rail, search->/properties with intent+location+type+beds+min+max querystring, Property Lab strategy tabs (incl. HMO with ILLUSTRATIVE label and lab-room-room1..5), featured 3 prototypes + 4th explore tile, finale CTAs, mobile hamburger and mobile panel all work. Only cosmetic follow-up would be to actually consume the ?intent=hmo|invest querystring on /properties (filter UI currently only offers ALL/BUY/RENT).
